title: Effects of the Music Care Therapeutic Music Intervention on Well-Being and Anxiety in Hospitalized Patients
official: Effet d'Une Intervention Musicale numérique Sur la Consommation de sédatifs et l'expérience Patient Lors de TAVI Sous sédation Consciente - Essai randomisé Monocentrique au Sein d'un Centre à Haut Volume
summary: This study aims to evaluate the effects of the Music Care therapeutic music intervention on participants' well-being, anxiety, and comfort. Participants will receive music sessions using the Music Care program in addition to their usual care. The study will assess whether this intervention can improve patient experience and quality of life.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 70 years (or \< 70 years if TAVI indication is validated by a multidisciplinary heart team \[MDT\]).
* Confirmed candidate for transfemoral TAVI under conscious sedation.
* Clinically stable patient, with no indication for general anesthesia, able to provide consent and understand the musical intervention.
* Able to understand how to use and wear headphones.
* Sufficient understanding of the French language.
* Signed, freely given, and informed consent.
* Affiliated with the French national health insurance system or an equivalent scheme.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication to conscious sedation (major hemodynamic instability, anticipated need for general anesthesia).
* Severe hearing impairment or hearing aids incompatible with headphones.
* Cognitive or psychiatric disorders preventing Numerical Rating Scale (NRS) assessment.
* Sound hypersensitivity or known intolerance to music.
* Participation in another interventional study.
* Explicit refusal of the musical intervention.
* Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
* Persons under legal protection (judicial safeguard).
